data.name: DreamFrame
data.description: DreamFrame is a decision-support tool for writers and directors. Paste or upload a script and a Gemini agent structures it into Acts, Scenes, and Characters. From there you can correct anything the model got wrong, cast each character with a 3D model, simulate the scene as a live turn-by-turn conversation (spoken with ElevenLabs).
